text: The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points.
It is not yet appropriate to raise the target range for the federal funds rate.
The Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points.
The Committee does not anticipate lowering the target range for the federal funds rate this year.
Some further policy firming may be appropriate to return inflation to two percent.
The Committee no longer judges that further policy firming will be appropriate.
Inflation remains elevated and broad-based across categories of goods and services.
Inflation is no longer broad-based across categories of goods and services.
Inflation has eased substantially over the past year toward the two percent objective.
Inflation has not eased over the past year and remains well above the two percent objective.
The labour market remains very tight and wage growth is adding to price pressure.
The labour market is not overheated and wage growth has moderated.
The Committee does not anticipate reducing the policy rate until it has greater confidence inflation is moving sustainably to two percent.
The Committee anticipates reducing the policy rate as inflation moves sustainably to two percent.
It will likely be appropriate to begin dialing back policy restraint this year.
It will not be appropriate to begin dialing back policy restraint this year.
The Bank is maintaining its policy of quantitative easing to provide monetary stimulus.
The Bank is no longer purchasing assets and has begun reducing its holdings.
Demand has softened and slack has emerged in the labour market.
Demand has not softened and no slack has emerged in the labour market.
The Committee will continue to monitor the implications of incoming information for the economic outlook.
The Committee is prepared to adjust the stance of monetary policy as appropriate if risks emerge.
The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at its current level.
The Bank maintained its target for the overnight rate at two and a quarter percent.
